cron_jobs.description: List of scheduled cron jobs. Each entry specifies time, user, and command.

minute.description: Minute(s) when the job runs (0–59, *, */n, or comma-separated list)

hour.description: Hour(s) when the job runs (0–23, *, */n, or list)

dow.description: Day(s) of week (0–6 or names, *, */n, or list)

user.description: User account under which the command runs

command.description: Command (with full path if needed) to execute
